personality_one_liner: A youthful, vibrant, and tactile social network that makes discovering and joining local plans feel exciting and approachable.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Use large tap targets. Avoid dense layouts.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar.
Use on sticky headers or bottom CTA containers (like the Unirme button).
Use over the hero photo in the parche details.
dont's: Do not use on list rows or normal cards.

screens.name: Onboarding_Interests
screens.purpose: Select 5 interests to personalize the feed.

states.error: Failed to load categories. Retry button.

screens.layout: Circular bubble UI for interests. Use flexWrap: 'wrap' and justifyContent: 'center' with gap md. Each item is a pill/circular chip with a thick blue border (borderStrong) when selected. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom using glassmorphism background.

screens.name: Home_Feed
screens.purpose: Instagram-style vertical feed of parches to discover and join.

states.empty: Illustration of friends, 'No parches nearby right now. Be the first to create one!'

screens.layout: Vertical scroll of large, tactile cards (shadow 2, radius lg). Each card has a top row (Avatar + Username + 'Detalles >'), a large edge-to-edge hero photo, and a bottom section with Title, Date, City, Participants (👥), Category Tag, and interactions (❤️, 💬, bookmark).

screens.name: Parche_Detail
screens.purpose: View parche information and join the plan.
screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image at the top with vertical gradient scrim to ensure back button readability. The content sits in a lifted surface pulled up over the image. Sticky bottom 'UNIRME' (Join) button wrapped in a glass container over scrollable content.

screens.name: Explore
screens.purpose: Search and filter parches by category, city, or date.
screens.layout: Sticky top search bar. Below it, a horizontally scrolling row of filter chips (Hoy, Esta semana, Cerca de mí). Below that, a 2-column grid (or masonry) of smaller parche cards.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User profile with stats, friends, and active parches.
screens.layout: Large circular avatar. Horizontal stat row (Amigos, Seguidores, Siguiendo, Parches). Large primary CTA button ('Enviar solicitud de amistad'). Below, a horizontally scrolling circular grid of interests. Bottom section uses top-tab navigation to switch between 'Mis Parches' and 'Etiquetas'.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL COLOR RULE EXCEPTION: The brief EXPLICITLY requested bright blue (#3B4CF6) and violet (#6B4EE6). This is a DIRECT OVERRIDE of the standard 'no blue/purple' rule. Do not replace these colors. Use them aggressively for branding as requested.
Implement expo-linear-gradient across main CTAs (like 'UNIRME') and large promotional elements, flowing from brandPrimary (blue) to brandSecondary (violet) to match LOPI's identity.
Typography: Use Fredoka for all headings to give a youthful, handwritten/rounded feel as requested. Use Nunito for readable body text.

Circular Categories: In the onboarding flow, build large circular chips for the interests. When selected, apply a thick blue border (`borderStrong`) and change the background tint. Use Phosphor icons (e.g., sports, music) inside them instead of emojis.
Feed Design: Follow the layout of Instagram. Use large images with the top row showing the creator's avatar and name. Make sure there are clear counters for likes, comments, and participants.
Always place a gradient scrim (top to bottom, transparent to dark) under text that sits on top of images (like the hero image in Parche Detail).
